subject.title: [F5] has_fallback=false despite model retry chains — fallback storms invisible in traces

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102051 as the canonical fix for this issue, or wait for/choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102046 instead?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same source-proven gap, and one has sufficient proof while the closing-syntax PR still needs proof; automation should not close this issue or choose the landing branch before maintainer review.

options.title: Use the proof-sufficient branch
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102051 after normal maintainer review, then close or supersede the sibling PRs for the same issue.

options.title: Wait for the closing PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102046 adds real behavior proof or is updated to match the preferred implementation shape.

options.title: Pause the cluster
options.body: Hold both open PRs if maintainers want a broader telemetry contract that includes a `has_fallback` alias or fallback-policy changes.

recommendation.title: Use the proof-sufficient branch
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102051 after normal maintainer review, then close or supersede the sibling PRs for the same issue.
